personal.summary: Versatile software engineer with a passion for building scalable applications and innovative solutions. Specialized in full-stack development with expertise in modern web technologies.

experiences.title: Staff Engineer
experiences.description: At Nintex, I serve as the lead front-end engineer for the Nintex Tables Project, where I steer large-scale feature development by collaborating with staff and principal engineers across multiple teams to define technical requirements and establish best practices for scalability and maintainability. I lead a team of three engineers in front-end development using React for a records management application, while also designing and developing an innovative AI Assistant framework using Langchain/Langgraph to enhance user experience in Nintex Workflow Cloud. My role encompasses full-stack responsibilities, including RESTful API development using .NET Core, and requires strong coordination with Product, UX, and Engineering Management stakeholders. I actively mentor junior front-end engineers on React and TypeScript best practices, while maintaining robust quality standards through comprehensive UI and API testing using Postman and Cypress, integrated into CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps. My technical expertise extends to Azure Cloud services including Azure Functions, Table/Blob Storage, and Azure Monitor (AppInsights), where I troubleshoot production issues and maintain system health through effective use of monitoring dashboards and metrics.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
experiences.description: As a Senior Software Engineer at Cyara, I played a pivotal role in enhancing the reliability and performance of the company's customer-facing platform. I architected and implemented a high-availability solution for the main Portal by migrating the caching layer to Redis, significantly improving system resilience. I designed and developed a micro frontend application using Angular v9 that enabled customers to seamlessly export items from Cyara's Portal into HP Quality Centre ALM. My contributions included feature development across multiple components using C#, ASP.NET MVC, and JavaScript, as well as modernizing the technology stack by upgrading jQuery from v1.9 to v3.5.1 across various components. I also tackled critical performance challenges by analyzing SQL blocking issues with SQL Profiler and conducting root cause analysis of performance and memory issues using APM tools like Sumologic and crash dump analysis.

experiences.title: Technical Lead
experiences.description: At Wipro, I served as Technical Lead for Shell's Petrel Plugin migration project, where I successfully led a cross-functional team of five professionals including two engineers, a QA specialist, a DevOps engineer, and a Scrum Master. Based out of Bengaluru, I spearheaded the migration of legacy Petrel plugins to newer versions, ensuring seamless transitions while maintaining critical functionality for Shell's operations. Following this, I transitioned to the role of Lead Developer for Powercor, where I designed and developed complex Oracle packages, leveraging my database expertise to deliver robust data solutions for enterprise applications.

experiences.title: Technical Architect
experiences.description: During my 11.5-year tenure at Infosys (May 2006 - November 2017), I served as Lead Developer and Architect for Schlumberger's IT transformation program, working across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Houston, and Sugarland, Texas. In this role, I was responsible for steering the design and development of REST APIs, ensuring adherence to REST API standards, reviewing pull requests, and providing guidance on API best practices. My work spanned diverse technical domains, including extensive development of Ocean for Petrel plugins for Schlumberger's Well Services division, where I led feasibility analysis and mentored junior developers. I specialized in building enterprise web and desktop applications using .NET, WPF, and Silverlight technologies, while working with databases including MS SQL and Firebird. Throughout my time at Infosys, I consistently took on leadership responsibilities including architecture design, code refactoring, configuration management, and mentoring team members on emerging frameworks and technologies
